lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with spot size and spatial separation increasing toward the posterior margin of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs posterior to the gills, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high-luminance highlights above and shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, high-luminance punctate spots is present on the dorsal surface of the head anterior to the gill slits, contrasting with the larger patterns on the flank.
